## Issue

Closes #

One issue. If this change closes two, it is two changes. If it closes none, the
first thing it needs is an issue: every change here starts as one.

## What changed

<!--
What a reader of the diff would otherwise have to work out for themselves.
-->

## What failure this prevents

<!--
The thing that goes wrong without this change. Where this is a correction, also
say what was wrong before and how it was found.
-->

## Evidence

<!--
Every number, state or fact asserted above carries the command that produced it,
run against the reference the reader will have rather than against your working
copy. Paste the command and its output.

Where a claim cannot be backed by a command, write it as a claim and say that it
is one.

Where this change adds a check that refuses something, show it biting: remove
what it refuses, run it, and paste the red output alongside the green.
-->

## What this change did not do

Anything skipped, deferred, not measured or not evaluated on this route stays
